name: Editorial Longform
tagline: Cream paper, Newsreader serif headlines in magazine columns, thin ink rules and one electric-violet accent for numbers and pull quotes (extended from a single-slide specimen)

palette.description: Warm paper white, deep ink, grey-violet secondary text and a single violet accent.

typography.style: Serif headline and justified two-column body with small letter-spaced Inter labels for mastheads and captions.

best_for: Narrative decks that read like a printed letter or feature story, with columns of prose, one large number and a pull quote. Suits foundations, annual reports and trust-building updates.
avoid_for: Fast keynote-style talks with minimal text.
